eval_dimensions.name: Approved Call Identification
eval_dimensions.description: Candidates are calls since the supervisor's previous message that prompted and ran, copied verbatim in the form triage needs (full Bash command, full MCP name, Read(<path>)); an explicit argument wins; nothing is guessed when no call prompted.

eval_dimensions.name: Ambiguous Candidate Gate
eval_dimensions.description: With two or three candidates, AskUserQuestion lists them newest first, with exactly one (Recommended) option leading and a final None of these option; a single candidate skips the question.

eval_dimensions.name: Delegation to permission-grant
eval_dimensions.description: The skill delegates via Skill(dev10x:permission-grant), never calls permission_grant itself, and closes with the outcome read from the delegated report.

evals.name: One approved Bash command is handed over verbatim
evals.input: Agent ran "rg -n 'allow' ~/.claude/settings.json", the supervisor approved the prompt, then invoked /dev10x:diag-approval

assertions.signal: verbatim_command — the handed-over target equals the approved command string exactly
single_candidate_skips_gate — no AskUserQuestion with one candidate
delegates — Skill(dev10x:permission-grant) is called with the target as args
no_direct_grant — the write tool is not called from this skill

evals.name: Two recent prompted calls trigger the candidate gate
evals.input: Agent ran 'make lint' and then 'mcp__plugin_x__tool', both prompted and were approved; supervisor invoked /dev10x:diag-approval

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion lists mcp__plugin_x__tool first as the only (Recommended) option, then make lint, then None of these

evals.name: No prompted call stops without guessing
evals.input: Supervisor invoked /dev10x:diag-approval at the start of a session

assertions.signal: stops_cleanly — output says nothing prompted since the last message, no target is guessed, and the task is completed
